Subject: Request: mutual action plan template & proposed evaluation cadence

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency numbers and the quality on our summary prompts. We have a couple of stakeholders who asked for a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) so we can align internal milestones and procurement steps.

Could you share:
- A short MAP template we can adapt (dates, owners, acceptance criteria)
- A recommended evaluation cadence (POC timeline, model/eval plan, blockers to watch for)
- Any paperwork we should expect for procurement (SLA, contract timeline)

We're aiming to have an internal decision meeting the week of 2026-03-22 — is that a realistic close target from your view?

Best,
Bryan
Bryan Keller
VP Product, BrightPath Analytics

Hi Bryan — really glad the demo resonated. Attached is a concise MAP template you can copy into your workspace and an initial draft of the MAP I started based on what we heard. I've also created a short slide deck for the evaluation criteria. Links below.

Proposed high-level timeline (suggested):
- Week of 2026-02-23: Share MAP and confirm stakeholders + key success metrics
- Week of 2026-03-01: POC kickoff (2-week technical validation)
- Week of 2026-03-15: Business evaluation & exec review
- Week of 2026-03-22: Final decision meeting / procurement kickoff

If you want to accelerate the POC we can compress technical validation to 1 week if BrightPath can commit an engineer for 2–4 hours/day.

Links / attachments:
- MAP template (attachment): MAP_template_redwood_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
- Initial MAP (editable Google Doc): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-MapInitialDraft
- Eval criteria slides (Google Slides): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1sLIDE-eval-slides

Next steps for us: Marissa will draft the acceptance criteria section and Ben will add recommended test prompts and pass/fail thresholds. Can you confirm who from BrightPath will own the security checklist and procurement? Also, is the week of 2026-03-22 still your target?

Thanks — talk soon.

Bryan / Liam — thanks for confirming stakeholders (Liam will handle security; HR will own procurement intake). We've updated the MAP with your internal owners and a sharpened acceptance criteria section. Key items in the updated MAP:

- Confirmed stakeholders: Liam O'Neill (Security), Priya Rao (Data Engineering), Emma Chen (Product)
- Acceptance criteria (summary):
  - Business: 10–15% improvement in summary recall for the pilot dataset (measured via the rubric in the slides)
  - Quality: average rubric score >= 3.8/5 across 10 validation prompts
  - Performance: 95th percentile latency < 220ms for 512-token generation (test harness included)
- POC plan: kickoff 2026-03-01, two-week technical validation, handoff to business review in week of 2026-03-15
- Target decision meeting: 2026-03-22 (we've reserved a tentative slot for 30 minutes)

Doc links (live):
- Editable MAP: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-MapInitialDraft (we've added comments for your security review)
- Eval slides & rubric: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1sLIDE-eval-slides

Attachments: MAP_template_redwood_v1.xlsx (xlsx) — feel free to copy and update for your procurement team.

If that timeline looks good, I'll submit a short mutual SLA addendum template to legal this week so procurement has an example to review. Marissa — when you have the acceptance criteria in the doc, I will share the final version with BrightPath and schedule the kickoff.

Cheers,
